nina: Quick q from a new customer onboarding: is backoff/retry parity between ruby and python SDKs specified anywhere? We're seeing different retry timings in our integration tests.

alex: We try to keep parity but there are historical differences (ruby used Faraday default retry middleware, python uses urllib3 with our custom backoff). Which behavior are you seeing?

nina: In our tests the ruby client retries immediately twice then waits ~2s, but python does exponential 0.5s, 1s, 2s. The logs show ruby using a linear backoff.

samir: Can you paste the client config? In ruby we ship a small Retry middleware but sampleapp historically relied on faraday-retry gem.

nina: Sampleapp config snippet:

```
Faraday.new(url: BASE_URL) do |f|
  f.request :retry, max: 3, interval: 0 # default faraday-retry
  f.request :json
  f.use RedwoodAuth
  f.adapter :net_http
end
```

nina: Looks like the sampleapp Gemfile pulls faraday-retry without our custom options so it behaves differently.

kate: Oof. For parity we should document the recommended retry policy and ship a small Redwood::Retry middleware in the gem with explicit exponential backoff default.

alex: Agreed. Add: 1) default exponential backoff (base 0.5s, factor 2, jitter 0.1), 2) idempotency-safe retries for POST-like endpoints unless user sets `retry_on_unsafe` true and warns in changelog.

samir: I'll open a tiny maintenance PR to add Redwood::Retry and change sampleapp to use it. Also add a test comparing ruby retry timings to a fixture showing expected intervals.

nina: Can we also add a note to onboarding docs so support doesn't triage as "network flakiness"? New customers get confused when SDKs behave differently.

alex: 100%. Add doc task to the PR description. @kate can you assign an owner for the docs follow-up?

kate: I can pick it up. I'll add a short section under SDK parity -> retry/backoff and include code examples for configuring behavior.

nina: Thanks folks! Small ask: please keep the default conservative (fewer retries) for hosted API to avoid slamming networks during incidents.

devex-bot: Reminder: link the PR to maintenance-0.6.x milestone and add reviewers @alex @samir.
